description: Ministry of Investment Promotion - The Colombo City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021, which establishes a legal/regulatory framework for development control in the Colombo Port City. The content consists entirely of detailed regulatory provisions, definitions, and technical requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
